Appearance

Lean, wiry man with sandy blond hair and a patchy beard. Wears deep forest green armor with thorn-like engravings and carries a bow.

What We Know

Member of the Nightstalkers adventuring party. A patron at the Sturdy Mugg. The group's ranged specialist.

First Impressions

Quiet and watchful — seems to notice everything from the corner of the room.
